capabilities: Record birthdays, anniversaries, and memorial dates with lunar or solar dates
Show countdowns and elapsed-day counts in a grouped sidebar dashboard
Send three-tier reminders via in-app popups and system notifications
Export events as iCal for system calendars
Embed an events board in notes via a jinianri code block
extras: Paid plugin with a 48-hour full-feature trial and per-device activation tied to a device fingerprint; first install pre-fills 3 sample events. Instructions are written in Chinese with an English section for community review.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track recurring personal dates like birthdays and anniversaries, especially lunar-calendar dates, with countdowns and reminders.
